one_line: A self-mocking pain line in text over one top-down demo that proves the fix in 10 seconds.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down on a grey stone surface: two blue schoolbooks, pink-nailed hands holding a large clear sleeve. No speech. Centred text: 'אם במקרה חייתן כמוני במערה בשנים האחרונות', then 'ועד היום עטפתן ספרים עם גליל ענק, מספריים ודמעות'.
q1_hook.why: A joke aimed at mothers who still wrap books the hard way, with the fix visible in the hands (H1, K3, S4). The pain, 'giant roll, scissors and tears', is a familiar back-to-school chore (K6). The first line is small and partly covered by the books, so it reads slowly (T5, H6).

beats.what: Hands hold a clear sleeve over two books; 'אם במקרה חייתן כמוני במערה'
beats.why: A joke about a chore, the fix in hand.

beats.what: A blue textbook is slid into the sleeve; 'ועד היום עטפתן ספרים עם גליל ענק, מספריים ודמעות'
beats.why: The old way named while the new way starts.

beats.what: An open hand smooths the sleeve flat; 'ורק עכשיו קניתן את הגאונות הזאת שלוקחת בדיוק 10 שניות...'
beats.why: The claim is proven in front of you.

beats.what: The book is flipped over; '😱 אז רק רציתי לעדכן שחסכתי יומיים עבודה'
beats.why: The saving, as a joke with an emoji.

beats.what: She fans the covered book, pages blur; 'ועכשיו אני לא יודעת מה לעשות 😮'
beats.why: A second joke, and the cover shown clear.

beats.what: Two covered books held up; '(...אם קניתן תרשמו באיזו חנות השגתן את זה) 😍 ובואו לעקוב'
beats.why: A useful question, then a follow ask.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 0:16: 'אם קניתן תרשמו באיזו חנות השגתן את זה'. Caption: 'כמה שנים אתן עוטפות ככה?' and 'אשמח אם תכתבו איפה מצאתן'. A back-to-school chore a mother might send to another mother.
q2_flow.why: A joke text and a visible fix at once open a loop that the 10-second claim closes, shown at normal speed (H5). New text every 2 to 4 s and a new hand action keep one take moving (R3). At 17 s it ends right after the last shot (R1, R2). A school chore to send to another mother (R5).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:16: '(...אם קניתן תרשמו באיזו חנות השגתן את זה)', 'ובואו לעקוב לעוד טיפים ממש פשוטים'. Caption: 'כמה שנים אתן עוטפות ככה?', 'אשמח אם תכתבו איפה מצאתן', and a follow ask.
q3_cta.why: The caption question, 'how many years have you wrapped like this', is open and answerable (C5, R6). 'Where did you find it' helps others, so it is not bait (C2). But there are three asks, and the video names no brand or store (C1, C6).

q4_shown.what: From 0:00, a clear plastic sleeve in hands and two school textbooks; a book slid in 0:03 to 0:05; smoothed flat 0:05 to 0:09; flipped 0:10; pages fanned 0:13; two covered books held up 0:16. No brand, no price.
q4_shown.why: The sleeve is handled in the first second and the whole job is shown in one take at normal speed, which is proof (S1, S4, F8). '10 seconds' is only text, and the product has no brand, price or store (S3, K4).

q5_edit.what: One continuous take of 17.6 s, no cuts, no speed changes. Text changes about every 3 s, white with a dark outline, 2 to 3 lines mid-frame, with emojis. No speech or sound the transcript shows. Ends on two covered books held up.
q5_edit.why: One steady take shows the job is not edited or sped up (E2), and a text change every 3 s paces it (R3). Short lines work muted (T1, T2). It stops on the final proof shot with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: Covering school textbooks with ready-made plastic sleeves instead of a roll and scissors. Serves mothers at the start of the school year.
q6_topic.why: A chore every school parent knows, at a clear buying moment, the start of the school year (K6, K7). The humour comes from the chore itself, not an unrelated gag (K3). The tip is practical and easy to save (K4, R7).

q7_filmed.what: Phone fixed above a grey stone surface, top-down, static, high angle. Pink-nailed hands only, no face, no child. Bright even daylight. Two blue schoolbooks, one with a visible title.
q7_filmed.why: A fixed top-down view of hands is the first-choice format and puts the viewer in the hands' place (S4, F5). The books and sleeve fill the frame (F4). Even light on a plain surface looks clean and homemade (F7, H8). Vertical, full screen (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: White text with a dark outline, small, 2 to 3 lines, centred at about 33 to 40% of the frame height, a new card every 2 to 4 s: 'אם במקרה חייתן כמוני במערה בשנים האחרונות' (0:00), 'ועד היום עטפתן ספרים עם גליל ענק, מספריים ודמעות' (0:02), 'ורק עכשיו קניתן את הגאונות הזאת שלוקחת בדיוק 10 שניות...' (0:06), '😱 אז רק רציתי לעדכן שחסכתי יומיים עבודה' (0:10).
q8_text.caption: 'חייתי במערה אחרת אין הסבר למה זו השנה הראשונה שאני עוטפת ככה.' About 70 words: 'רוצו לקנות את זה', a question to readers, 'אשמח אם תכתבו איפה מצאתן', a follow ask, 4 hashtags (#מאמאשפשוט, #הורות, #טיפים, #ביתספר).
q8_text.why: The joke is told in text with emojis and works muted (T1, T2), sits above the bottom 35% (T4, F2), but is small, and a line can be read only once each (T5). The caption's first line continues the joke, with a back-to-school hashtag and an open question, but names no product (T7, C5).

weak_points: Small text read once; no brand, store or price, so the question 'where' is left to commenters; three asks in the caption; the 'two days saved' claim is unproven.
lumebook_takeaway: A silent top-down take on a table: the parcel opened, the book out, a page turned to the name. A joke line first, then the proof, one comment question.
not_verified: The product brand and where it is sold; whether any music plays (the transcript shows none); whether she was paid (no disclosure, label 0). Correction: the text sits at about 33 to 40% of the frame height, in the middle, and the first line is partly over the books.
